error.weather_key_required: Enter a Pirate Weather API key, or switch the source to a weather entity.

user.title: View Assist Rundown Tweaks
user.description: Start with a blank Rundown, or bring over the settings from a standalone rundown.html setup.

fresh.title: Weather and clock
fresh.description: Everything else (background photos, calendar, tasks, transit, layout, View Assist views) is set under Configure after setup.

data_description.weather_entity: Any Home Assistant weather entity. No API key needed.
data_description.weather_key: Free key from pirateweather.net. Only used when the source is Pirate Weather.

import_legacy.title: Import rundown-config.json
import_legacy.description: Path relative to your config folder. API keys, entities, layout and weather rotation are imported. The Home Assistant long-lived token is deliberately not imported: the integration signs in as whoever is viewing the page. After importing, delete the old file from www/ — anything under www/ can be downloaded without signing in.

error.weather_entity_required: Choose a weather entity, or switch the source to Pirate Weather.
error.weather_key_required: Enter a Pirate Weather API key, or switch the source to a weather entity.
error.folder_not_found: Folder not found inside your config folder.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http(s):// or webcal:// URL.
error.custom_feed_required: Enter the RSS feed URL for the custom source.
error.ms_client_id_required: Microsoft To Do needs an Azure app Client ID.
error.view_assist_missing: View Assist is not installed, so its views and sidebar cannot be added.
error.widget_outside_grid: {widget} runs past the edge of the grid. Reduce its width or height, move it, or add grid columns or rows.
error.no_slides: Turn on at least one small screen section.

init.title: Rundown settings
init.description: Edit any section, then choose **Save** to apply. Open Rundown screens pick up changes within a minute.

data.mobile_breakpoint: Small screen layout at or below this height
data.load_fonts: Load IBM Plex fonts from Google Fonts

data_description.text_shadow: Dark halo behind text so it stays readable over bright photos.
data_description.mobile_breakpoint: Screens this short or shorter (e.g. 960×480 View Assist tablets) get the rotating small screen layout. Choose its sections under Content.
data_description.load_fonts: Also adds the font stylesheet as a dashboard resource for the View Assist clock view.

data_description.bg_folder: Folder inside your config directory, e.g. rundown_photos. Photos are only served to signed-in users.
data_description.bg_images: One per line: file names from the folder (in this order) or full image URLs. Leave empty to use every image in the folder.

data_description.latitude: Pirate Weather only. Leave empty to use your Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Pirate Weather only. Leave empty to use your Home Assistant location.
data_description.wx_slides_enabled: Slide order can be dragged in the page's layout editor (weather ⚙).
data_description.wx_city_name: Shown in the broadcast-style header. Leave empty to hide.

data.cors_proxy_fallback: Fall back to public CORS proxies

data_description.ticker_source: The other built-in feed is used automatically if the primary one fails.
data_description.cors_proxy_fallback: Feeds and your calendar are normally fetched by Home Assistant itself. Only turn this on if that fails; it sends the calendar link (including its private token) through third-party proxy services.

data_description.ics_url: Fetched by Home Assistant, so it never reaches the browser unless proxy fallback is on.
data_description.graph_url: Alternative to ICS. Used only when no ICS URL is set.

data.todo_overdue_days: Hide tasks overdue by more than
data.todo_future_days: Hide tasks due further out than
data.todo_show_undated: Show tasks with no due date

data_description.todo_entities: Any Home Assistant to-do lists. Leave empty to use every Todoist list.

data_description.ms_client_id: Register a Single-page application with redirect URI https://<your-ha>/va_rundown_tweaks/static/rundown.html, then use Link Microsoft in the page's layout editor.
data_description.ms_refresh_token: Filled in automatically by Link Microsoft, and kept up to date as Microsoft rotates it.

scripture.title: Scripture
scripture.description: Verse of the day in the Scripture widget.

data_description.esv_key: From api.esv.org. Without a key a built-in verse rotation is shown.

now_playing.title: Now playing
now_playing.description: The Now Playing widget appears only while Last.fm reports a track playing.

data_description.door_entity: Shows a warning while this is on/open.
data_description.broadcast_entity: A text helper an automation fills from an Assist broadcast; each new value is shown once.
data_description.thermostat_entity: Current temperature shown under the weather gauge and on the View Assist clock view.

view_assist.title: View Assist & sidebar panel
view_assist.description: View Assist changes are applied to the View Assist dashboard when you save. The views are written to config/view_assist/views/ — copy a view's file to user_<name>.yaml there to customise it.

data.clock_thermostat: Show the thermostat on the clock view
data.install_app_view: Add full-screen Rundown as a View Assist view

data_description.install_app_view: Adds a "rundowntweaks" view to the View Assist dashboard that fills the whole screen. Open it with view_assist.navigate (path /view-assist/rundowntweaks), add view:rundowntweaks to a device's menu items, or make it a device's home screen.
data_description.install_clock_view: To make it a device's home screen, set its home view to /view-assist/rundowntweaksclock in View Assist.
data_description.sidebar_mode: Shows the View Assist device's menu items as a floating bar. "All views" is skipped if your dashboard already adds a view-assist-menu-card.

content.title: Content
content.description: Choose what Rundown shows. **Full screen** is the grid layout used on larger displays; **Small screen** is the rotating one-section-at-a-time layout used at or below the height set under Display.

content_full_screen.title: Full screen content
content_full_screen.description: Turn widgets on or off and place them on the grid. Column and row count from 1 at the top-left; width and height are in grid cells. You can also drag and resize widgets on the page itself: tap the RUNDOWN logo 5 times as an admin. Changes made there are saved here. Hiding the Logo also hides that way into the layout editor.

widget_nowplaying.name: Now playing
widget_nowplaying.description: Only appears while Last.fm reports a track playing.

widget_haalerts.name: HA alerts
widget_haalerts.description: Only appears while an alert is active. Shares its place with Now playing by default; an active alert takes priority.

content_small_screen.title: Small screen content
content_small_screen.description: Choose which sections rotate, their order (position 1 goes first) and how long each stays up. The progress dots show only the sections currently in the rotation.

data_description.mobile_hide_errors: Skip Weather, Agenda, Metro or To Do while their data fails to load or they are not configured. They rejoin the rotation once they load again.

data_description.show: Takes a turn only when a WMATA key and stations are set.

data_description.duration: 0 = automatic: long enough for every forecast product. Any other value shortens or stretches each product to fit.

data_description.show: Takes a turn only while Last.fm reports a track playing.
Takes a turn only while a door or broadcast alert is active, and jumps in as soon as one starts.
data_description.duration: 0 = stay on screen until the alert clears.

install_view_assist_assets.name: Install View Assist assets
install_view_assist_assets.description: Re-apply the Rundown views and sidebar to the View Assist dashboard according to the integration options.

force.name: Force
force.description: Reinstall views even if they look up to date.

remove_view_assist_assets.name: Remove View Assist assets
remove_view_assist_assets.description: Remove the Rundown views and sidebar from the View Assist dashboard (options are left unchanged).
